name: Absorption native work final UI publication completes saved return

condition.code:
local tx=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState().Transactions['native-product-return-probe']
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
for _,city in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do
 local live=CityManager.GetCityAt(city.X,city.Y)
 if not live or live:GetOwner()~=tx.To then return false end
 local ok,value=pcall(reads.ReadCity,tx.To,live:GetID(),'LOYALTY')
 if not ok or type(value)~='number' then return false end
end
for _,unit in ipairs(tx.Units or {}) do
 for _,read in pairs(unit.SpreadReads or {}) do
  if read.AwaitingUI and reads.GetUnitObservation(read.Token)==nil then return false end
 end
end
if tx.AwaitingFinalUI and not reads.GetObservation(tx.ID..':final') then return false end
return true

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
local before=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
local external,ordinary
for _,work in ipairs(before.NativeWorks or {}) do if work.Custodian then external=work else ordinary=work end end
assert(external and external.PhysicalMoved and external.TargetSlot,'saved external work was not physically proved')
local tx=A.Resume(id)
local located=A.NativeWorkLocations(external.Source.Index)
assert(#located==1,'returned original index missing or duplicated after saved resume')
local w=located[1];local slot=external.TargetSlot
assert(w.Owner==slot.Owner and w.CityID==slot.City and w.X==slot.X and w.Y==slot.Y and w.Building==slot.Building and w.Slot==slot.Slot,'returned original left the reserved official slot')
local source=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(external.Source.X,external.Source.Y))
assert(source:GetOwner()==tx.To,'old donor city not transferred to absorber')
local assets=A.CityAssets(source)
assert(assets[external.Source.BuildingType].Works[external.Source.Slot]==-1,'old donor source slot not empty')
local movedCities=0
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(snap.X,snap.Y));if city:GetOwner()==tx.To then movedCities=movedCities+1 end end
assert(movedCities==#tx.Cities,'not all old cities moved to absorber')
if tx.Status=='COMPLETE' then
 assert(A.Verify(id,false),'completed product verification failed')
 local returned=assert(A.GetRoster(external.Custodian)[external.ID])
 assert(returned.NativeWork.Index==w.Index and returned.NativeCustody.Owner==w.Owner and returned.NativeCustody.City==w.CityID and returned.NativeCustody.Building==w.Building and returned.NativeCustody.Slot==w.Slot,'returned work custody ledger differs from official slot')
 if ordinary then local own=A.NativeWorkLocations(ordinary.Source.Index);assert(#own==1 and own[1].Owner==tx.To,'ordinary work lost on city transfer');local record=assert(A.GetRoster(tx.To)[ordinary.ID]);assert(record.NativeCustody.Owner==own[1].Owner and record.NativeCustody.City==own[1].CityID and record.NativeCustody.Building==own[1].Building and record.NativeCustody.Slot==own[1].Slot,'ordinary work ledger differs from official slot') end
end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_FINISH] status='..tx.Status..' cities='..movedCities..'/'..#tx.Cities..' returnIndex='..w.Index..' destination='..w.Owner..':'..w.CityID..':'..w.Building..':'..w.Slot..' finalUI='..tostring(tx.AwaitingFinalUI))
return 'saved native product absorption status '..tx.Status
